spec.description: A burndown chart for a home mortgage.

spec.expression:
SELECT
  A.Date AS __time__,
  (
    SELECT
      MAX(`Current Home Value`)
    FROM
      B
  ) - A.Amount AS `Home Equity`
FROM
  A
WHERE
  A.Description = 'Outstanding Principal'
ORDER BY
  A.Date
LIMIT
  1000

spec.title: Mortgage Progress
